## About This Project

This project explores putting performance on the PGA Tour by examining the **average number of putts per round** across 26,442 tournament appearances from 2015 to 2023. Using official PGA Tour ShotLink data (Stat 119), we analyze tour-wide variation on the greens and compare how the top 25 golfers from the 2024 FedExCup standings perform relative to the tour baseline.
